attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Idaho corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or doing business in Idaho.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Idaho Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false /result.id_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus or doing business threshold

action_details.action_postfix: true /result.id_has_nexus xdef "Idaho filing required: Physical presence (office, employees, or property in state)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus or doing business - filing required
action_details.action_postfix: true /result.id_has_nexus xdef "Idaho filing required: Economic nexus or doing business in Idaho" job.audit_trail swap addto
false /result.id_has_nexus xdef 0.0 /result.id_tax_liability xdef "Idaho filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Idaho state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. ID requires addback of state taxes deducted federally and allows subtraction of U.S. government interest.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Idaho Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.id_state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.id_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Idaho state additions and subtractions

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.id_state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.id_state_subtractions xdef "Idaho adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Idaho corporate income tax. Applies Idaho flat rate (5.3%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Idaho Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.id_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.id_tax_liability xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.id_apportioned_income result.id_state_additions add result.id_state_subtractions sub 0.0 max /result.id_taxable_income xdef
result.id_taxable_income result.id_corp_tax_rate mul /id_tax_before_credits xdef
id_tax_before_credits result.id_state_credits sub 0.0 max /result.id_tax_liability xdef
result.id_estimated_payments result.id_tax_liability sub /result.id_refund_or_owed xdef
"Idaho taxable income: $" result.id_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Idaho tax liability (5.3%): $" result.id_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.id_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.id_tax_liability xdef result.id_estimated_payments /result.id_refund_or_owed xdef "Idaho tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.id_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.id_tax_liability xdef result.id_estimated_payments /result.id_refund_or_owed xdef "Idaho tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
